1.1.field_title: Does the participant receive adequate sleep (> 6 hrs per night)?

1.2.field_title: Has the participant smoked more than 100 cigarettes or 1 cigar or used nicotine/smokeless tobacco products more than once?

1.3.field_title: Select tobacco products (check all that apply)
1.3.field_constraint_data:
Cigarettes|e-Cigarettes|Cigars, cigarillos, or filtered little cigars|Smokeless tobacco (chewing tobacco, snuff, dip, snus, or dissolvable tobacco)|Pipes (regular pipes, water pipes, or hookahs)|Other
>is_shown_fg=$(smoked_100_cigarettes)=='true'

1.5.field_title: Does the participant currently use cigarettes, cigars, other nicotine or smokeless tobacco products?

1.6.field_title: Select tobacco products (check all that apply)
1.6.field_constraint_data:
Cigarettes|e-Cigarettes|Cigars, cigarillos, or filtered little cigars|Smokeless tobacco (chewing tobacco, snuff, dip, snus, or dissolvable tobacco)|Pipes (regular pipes, water pipes, or hookahs)|Other
>is_shown_fg=$(currently_uses_tobacco)=='true'

1.8.field_title: Does the participant get regular exercise (>20 min per day, 3 or more times per week)?

1.9.field_title: Does the participant eat a high quality diet (plenty of vegetables, modest protein, minimal processed foods)?

1.10.field_title: Does the participant limit alcohol intake (one or less drinks per day)?

1.11.field_title: Has the participant ever taken illicit or recreational drugs?

1.12.field_constraint_data:
Cannabinoids (Marijuana, Hashish)|Opioids (Heroin, Opium)|Stimulants (Cocaine, Amphetamine, Methamphetamine)|Club Drugs (MDMA, Flunitrazepam, GHB)|Dissociative Drugs (Ketamine, PCP and analogs, Salvia divinorum, Dextromethorphan (DXM))|Hallucinogens (LSD, Mescaline, Psilocybin)|Prescription Medications (CNS Depressants, Stimulants, Opioid Pain Relievers)|Other Compounds (Anabolic steroids, Inhalants)
>is_shown_fg=$(recreational_drugs)=='true'

1.14.field_title: Does the participant engage in greater than 2 hrs of non-work screentime per day?

1.15.field_title: Does the participant have a strong social support system?

1.16.field_title: Does the participant regulary enjoy leisure and/or social activities?
